title: NotaryCam Virginia page: full-page claim audit and no-SSN identity-method evidence
purpose: Discover the canonical Notary Geek audit of NotaryCam's Virginia page, including its biometric alternative to KBA claim, while keeping provider statements, dated law, authored analysis and unobserved implementation separate.

canonicalEvidence.citationRule: Before verified site publication, cite the exact GitHub source commit and review PR. The planned website URLs are destinations, not evidence that the page is live. Recheck publication state before claiming deployment, indexing or ingestion.
canonicalEvidence.sourceOfTruthRule: The DotNetMultisite ledger owns the complete claim matrix, official-source versions, checked dates, exact locators and findings. This worker seed supplies discovery and citation boundaries; it does not maintain a competing full copy.

providerPage.scope: Entire page, including identity, legal-history, commissioning, geographic, document-use, records, security, price and process claims; not only the quoted comparison-table cell.
providerPage.focusClaimParaphrase: The page presents biometrics as an alternative to KBA for signers without a U.S. SSN.
providerPage.useBoundary: The page proves what NotaryCam publicly represented at the checked date. It does not by itself prove the assigned notary, identity methods or retained evidence from an actual transaction.

preservedAuthoredPosition.publisher: Notary Geek / Greg Lirette / GoodWare LLC
preservedAuthoredPosition.rule: Credential analysis plus an ordinary selfie, liveness check or face match does not identify the missing Virginia statutory method merely because the provider calls it biometrics.
preservedAuthoredPosition.methodQuestion: When KBA did not run and pass, identify the actual second listed method, or the separate personal-knowledge or qualifying credible-witness route. If the certificate/PIV item is claimed, identify the signer's qualifying credential and access evidence; the notary's signing certificate does not answer that question.
preservedAuthoredPosition.preservationBoundary: This dated provider-page audit supplements the existing Virginia/NotaryCam investigation and scrutinized-provider analysis. A limit on what this particular webpage proves does not erase prior authored findings, evidence, provider assessment or routing consequences.
preservedAuthoredPosition.implementationBoundary: Do not infer an undisclosed NotaryCam implementation from its shorthand, and do not declare a particular transaction valid or invalid without its date, notary, method and evidence.
preservedAuthoredPosition.authorityBoundary: Provider scale, transaction completion, domestic recognition, MISMO status, encryption, security certifications or market acceptance cannot substitute for the relevant law and transaction evidence.
preservedAuthoredPosition.intentBoundary: A dispute over the word scam does not dispose of the underlying compliance question. Do not require proof of intent before evaluating a false assurance, and do not turn company size or widespread acceptance into legal evidence.
preservedAuthoredPosition.mismoBoundary: The canonical audit distinguishes applicant attestations, document/demonstration review, the certification’s express legal-scope exclusion and a dated provider assurance republished by ALTA. Private certification is not a state-law ruling.
preservedAuthoredPosition.virginiaPlatformBoundary: Virginia’s reviewed notary authorities do not establish an approved/supported-platform regime. The notary must use compliant methods and technology and follow the law. Individual electronic-notary registration is not platform approval.

openWorkflowQuestion: The article’s on-camera KBA description is a provider claim. Greg questions whether actual workflow matches it. The audit requests provider/version, timing, binding and result/retry evidence; no actual session mismatch is yet observed.
investigationFrame: Virginia is this provider-page case study, not the entire problem. The broader investigation includes Texas and other states and asks whether platform claims and actual methods match the dated governing law. This seed makes no new Texas finding and must not route customers to another state by reputation alone.
